title: makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn discards appendOutcomeOnMain's structured result, so…
description:
makeRecordPatternOutcomeFn discards appendOutcomeOnMain's structured result, so a per-id failure (diverged, detached-head, missing-main, not-found) is skip-and-ignored with no logEvent. This is documented as deliberate best-effort, and it is not a silently swallowed error in practice (checkMainUpToDate and the not-found path both printError to the operator, as visible in the test-suite stderr). Consider folding a durable logEvent on a non-ok result so a persistently diverged main shows up in cam-worker-events.jsonl rather than only in transient stderr.
